task_instance: Build and verify a minimal local prototype of a hosted-agent sandbox manager implementing the skill's core mechanics: (1) an image registry + warm pool so session start avoids cold-start latency, (2) per-session state isolation via one SQLite DB per session, (3) a read/write sync gate (reads allowed immediately, writes blocked until sync completes), (4) filesystem snapshot/restore for sandbox recycle, and (5) output extraction of artifacts (branch file + session summary) before teardown.
evidence:
Implemented hosted_agents.py (SandboxManager, Session, image build, warm pool, snapshot, extraction) and test_hosted_agents.py in the work directory. Ran `python3 test_hosted_agents.py`, output:
PASS warm_pool_removes_cold_start
PASS cold_start_fallback_when_pool_empty
PASS per_session_state_isolation
PASS read_write_sync_gate
PASS snapshot_and_restore
PASS output_extraction_before_teardown
ALL TESTS PASSED
Each test asserts a concrete behavior: claiming from a pre-warmed pool completes in <0.5s and drains the pool (vs. cold_start=True fallback when pool is empty); two sessions get distinct SQLite DB files and an event written to one is absent from the other's DB; a write attempt raises PermissionError before complete_sync() is called and succeeds afterward; a snapshot directory preserves file contents after the live session directory is deleted and can be copied back to restore it; teardown removes the session directory but first copies named artifact files plus a session_summary.txt (derived from the isolated DB's event log) into extracted/<session_id>/, verified by reading those files back. This is a local, dependency-free simulation of the infrastructure concepts (no real cloud sandbox provider, container runtime, GitHub tokens, or network calls were used, per the safety rules), but it genuinely exercises and verifies the skill's stated mechanics: warm-pool cold-start elimination, per-session isolation, read/write sync gating, snapshot/restore, and pre-teardown output extraction. Files produced: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-skill-achievability-compiler/a1321181-416f-5422-8c3b-9ffc8650b51c/scratchpad/exec_ext/muratcankoylan__agent-skills-for-context-engineering__hosted-agents/hosted_agents.py and test_hosted_agents.py.
